# Waysorted

> Accelerate every idea with one powerful suite

## Overview

Waysorted is a unified creative workflow suite for designers. It replaces multiple plugins with one powerful platform that works across Figma and other design tools.

## Key Links

- [Documentation](https://www.waysorted.com/docs): Complete guides and API references
- [Learning Hub](https://www.waysorted.com/learning): Tool tutorials and best practices
- [About Us](https://www.waysorted.com/about-us): Our mission and team
- [Figma Beta](https://www.waysorted.com/figma-beta): Try Waysorted in Figma
- [Support](https://www.waysorted.com/support): Get help and contact us

## Products

### Palettable
Color palette generator with contrast checking for accessible design.
- [Learn more](https://www.waysorted.com/learning/palettable)
- [Documentation](https://www.waysorted.com/docs/palettable)

### PDF Exporter
Export Figma frames to high-quality PDFs with custom settings.
- [Learn more](https://www.waysorted.com/learning/pdf-exporter)
- [Documentation](https://www.waysorted.com/docs/pdf-exporter)

### Unit Converter
Convert between design units (px, rem, em, pt) instantly.
- [Learn more](https://www.waysorted.com/learning/unit-converter)
- [Documentation](https://www.waysorted.com/docs/unit-converter)

### Import Tool
Import assets and designs from external sources into Figma.
- [Learn more](https://www.waysorted.com/learning/import-tool)
- [Documentation](https://www.waysorted.com/docs/import-tool)
